reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Patient-paired multiomic treatment-associated program discovery, assay-specific preprocessing, primary late integration/enrichment and locked external cohort validation.

checks.quote: # Design for Identifying a Reproducible Treatment-Associated Multi-Omics Program from Paired Tumor Samples
checks.reason: No explicit pre-execution plan to consult original assay Methods, supplements or validated analysis protocols and check their transfer to the present inputs.

checks.quote: Loses the pairing advantage and inflates apparent sample size
checks.reason: Using all 60 samples does not inherently lose pairing; a correctly specified patient-blocked or repeated-measures joint model preserves it. The categorical rejection is factually wrong.

checks.quote: RNA/protein carry the causal-inference weight
checks.reason: Neither RNA/protein nor a paired uncontrolled cohort establishes treatment causality; time/progression/handling remain alternatives.

checks.quote: fewer than ~20 patients
checks.reason: The cutoff is asserted without a program-specific variance/effect/precision justification. A generic instruction to compute Procrustes power does not justify this cutoff.

checks.quote: # Design for Identifying a Reproducible Treatment-Associated Multi-Omics Program from Paired Tumor Samples
checks.reason: No primary test of the patient-level mean treatment-associated program change and its uncertainty is specified; heterogeneity/subgroup structure is a different estimand.

checks.quote: batch is not time-confounded
checks.reason: RNA/protein batch-time independence is asserted without support from M2. Naming MOFA-class alternatives also does not specify the factor likelihood and assumptions needed to distinguish shared nuisance variation.

checks.quote: # Design for Identifying a Reproducible Treatment-Associated Multi-Omics Program from Paired Tumor Samples
checks.reason: No bounded factor-count/filter/model search or concrete procedure deriving bounds and stop before lock.

checks.quote: # Design for Identifying a Reproducible Treatment-Associated Multi-Omics Program from Paired Tumor Samples
checks.reason: No refreeze and fresh independent confirmation after changing the model or processing following a failure.

checks.quote: the reported program is an artifact of the missingness pattern, not biology
checks.reason: Divergence from complete-case analysis can reflect selection of a different patient population or uncertainty, not prove an artifact. Likewise, different external processing does not itself prove a technical explanation for failed validation.

checks.quote: discovery–validation correlation of factor loading vectors
checks.reason: The protocol freezes loadings and forbids refitting, so correlating those same loading vectors or their enrichment is tautological. Procrustes/Mantel comparison of unrelated patient score matrices also lacks matched observations. These cannot independently validate the program.

checks.quote: # Design for Identifying a Reproducible Treatment-Associated Multi-Omics Program from Paired Tumor Samples
checks.reason: No immutable input hashes, exact computational environment/commands/seeds and complete raw-data/output provenance.

checks.quote: center/scale using discovery-set parameters only
checks.reason: Whole-discovery centering/scaling is not refitted in each training fold for internal reconstruction/stability evaluation.

checks.quote: shuffle Δ-vectors across patients
checks.reason: Jointly permuting rows of all delta matrices leaves their feature covariance and unsupervised loading structure unchanged. This is not a null for factor enrichment/program existence; permuting views separately would test a different hypothesis and must be specified.

checks.quote: # Design for Identifying a Reproducible Treatment-Associated Multi-Omics Program from Paired Tumor Samples
checks.reason: No clean-environment numerical reproduction, output tolerances or resource/failure/source-difference logs.

checks.quote: # Design for Identifying a Reproducible Treatment-Associated Multi-Omics Program from Paired Tumor Samples
checks.reason: The answer proposes good manifests, identity checks and technical normalization calibration, but the principal external-validation statistic reuses fixed loadings and cannot provide new evidence. Row-permutation and causal claims compound the problem; specific checks avoid duplicate charges.
